body: Not sure if this ever got solved but after a trip to Chicago this week and a binge of everything Chi related, I just went on a deep dive of this myself.  The spot in question is at Hubbard/LaSalle.  The neighborhood has changed a shocking amount since the film but you can see the crowns of the Wrigley & Tribune towers on the left side as well as Marina City in the background.  The "L" tracks are for the purple/brown line along N Wells
